Rick van Logchem <vanlogchem@essb.eur.nl>:
Hi Amin, Thanks for your quick reply! Very much appreciate the help, especially in the weekend. To answer your questions:1. The study is open to the public (we provide participants with the registration code, after which they enroll themselves through the app)2. NA as the study only requires the registration code to enroll.3. The study start time is set on monday oct 21st. As far as I am aware we haven't set a specific closing date. I just tested this quickly by enrolling myself in the study on my phone, which worked perfectly. The app itself seems to work for this participant. They have made an Avicenna account (ID 101409) and can navigate the app. They tried to register for our study by filling in the registration code, but it seems they get stuck at trying to accept the consent materials as nothing happens when they click the join / accept button. Best regards,Rick
